title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
description: Build foundational cloud knowledge for Azure certification. Covers cloud computing concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Azure compute, storage, and networking services, identity management with Azure Active Directory, security best practices, compliance, SLAs, and Azure pricing models. Prepares for AZ-900 exam.

title: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
description: Gain foundational knowledge of AI and ML on Azure. Covers responsible AI principles, computer vision (Azure Vision API, Face API), natural language processing (Language Service, QnA Maker), conversational AI (Azure Bot Service), and document intelligence. Prepares for AI-900 exam.

title: Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)
description: Learn to build business apps, automate workflows, and create data visualizations without coding. Covers Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows), Power BI dashboards, Power Virtual Agents chatbots, and Microsoft Dataverse. Prepares for PL-900 exam.

title: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
description: Understand Microsoft's security ecosystem — Zero Trust model, shared responsibility, identity & access management with Azure AD, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel SIEM, Purview compliance portal, and eDiscovery. Essential foundation for any security or compliance role on Azure.

title: Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure (AZ-204)
description: Build and implement cloud-native solutions on Azure. Covers Azure App Service, Azure Functions (serverless), Blob Storage, Cosmos DB, API Management, Azure Cache for Redis, Event Grid, Service Bus, and Azure Monitor. Prepares for AZ-204 Developer Associate certification.

title: Microsoft Azure Security Technologies (AZ-500)
description: Implement and manage Azure security controls. Covers identity and access (PIM, MFA, Conditional Access), network security (NSGs, Firewall, DDoS), data security (Key Vault, Azure Defender for SQL), and security operations with Microsoft Sentinel. Prepares for AZ-500 Security Engineer Associate.

title: Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900)
description: Explore core data concepts for Azure. Covers relational data (Azure SQL, Structured Query Language), non-relational data (Azure Cosmos DB, Blob Storage), data analytics (Azure Synapse, HDInsight, Databricks), and data visualization with Power BI. Prepares for DP-900 certification.

title: Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
description: Administer Azure infrastructure at scale. Master Azure virtual machines, virtual networks, NSGs, load balancers, Azure DNS, storage accounts, Azure Backup, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics workspaces, and role-based access control (RBAC). Prepares for AZ-104 Administrator Associate exam.

title: GitHub Copilot Fundamentals — AI-Powered Development
description: Learn to write code faster and smarter with GitHub Copilot. Covers AI pair programming fundamentals, prompt engineering for code generation, using Copilot for documentation, test generation, debugging, and refactoring. Understand responsible AI use in software engineering.

title: Develop Generative AI Solutions with Azure OpenAI Service
description: Build production-grade AI applications using Azure OpenAI. Covers GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper, embeddings, prompt engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search with Azure AI Search, responsible AI deployment, content filtering, and monitoring at scale.
